verdict.rationale: MoonPay documents a dedicated Quotes API (locked rate, fees, signature) and both widget/SDK get-quote methods with expiring quotes, plus buy/sell flows and marketing mention of cross-chain token swaps (moonpay-docs-14, -36, -18, -23). However, settlement-time documentation is absent, and stablecoin-to-stablecoin conversion is only referenced at a marketing level, not as a documented API endpoint. missing for 10: explicit settlement-time documentation, dedicated stablecoin-to-stablecoin API endpoint docs, independent corroboration of rate/fee accuracy.
